ma.getStorage(Object object)

Asynchronously obtain the content of a specified key from the local cache.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
key String Yes Specified key in the local cache.
encrypt Boolean false No Whether to enable encrypted storage (new parameter in version 23.12.0)
success Function No Callback function for a successful API call.
fail Function No Callback function for a failed API call.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

object.success Callback Function

Parameter
Object res
Attribute Type Description
errMsg String getStorage: ok
data Any Content corresponding to the key.

Sample Code

    ma.getStorage({
      key: 'key',
      encrypt: true,
      success (res) {
        console.log(res.data)
      }
    })

Tips

  1. Currently, only the asynchronous interface getStorage is supported to enable encrypted storage. When enabled, data will be decrypted using AES256, and the interface callback time will increase.
  2. If encrypted storage is enabled, setStorage and getStorage need to declare the value of encrypt to be true at the same time.
